holdings.EXPERTS: S/RES/2688 (2023), paras. 5–6. The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024 and intended to review it and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council after discussion with the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group was to send monthly updates to the Committee except in the two report-due months.

holdings.SANCTIONS: S/RES/2688 (2023), paras. 1–3. The Council renewed the measures in paragraphs 1–6 of resolution 2293 (2016) until 1 July 2024. It reiterated that the measures in paragraph 1 of resolution 1807 (2008) continue to apply to nongovernmental entities and individuals operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
